title: 9 Best AI Sales Prospecting Tools: Compared for SDRs (2026)
summary: Compare 16 sales prospecting tools by job: contact data, LinkedIn, enrichment, email outreach and calling. Free plan limits and paid prices, November 15, 2026.
body_markdown:
Sales prospecting tools, also sold as sales prospecting software, help a sales rep find people to sell to and start a conversation with them. They do four jobs: find contacts, enrich and research them, reach out by email or LinkedIn, and call. This guide compares 16 tools by job. On November 15, 2026, six of them showed a free plan on their own pricing page: Apollo, Clay, HubSpot Sales Hub, Hunter, Kaspr and Lusha. Twelve published a price for a paid plan, and four showed no price.


For contact data, compare Apollo, Cognism, Hunter, Kaspr, Lusha, RocketReach, UpLead and ZoomInfo. For LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator. For research and enrichment, Clay. For email outreach and sequencing, HubSpot Sales Hub, Instantly, lemlist, Outreach and Salesloft. For calling, Trellus, which has no free plan and no free trial.


*Trellus publishes this guide and is one of the products in it. Details about other products come from each vendor’s own website, read on November 15, 2026. Nothing here is a hands-on test or a ranking; the table is grouped by job and alphabetical inside each group.*


## Sales prospecting tools compared by job


Grouped by job, with tools in alphabetical order inside each group. Free plans and prices are as shown on each vendor’s own pricing page on November 15, 2026. Tool Job What its site says it does Free plan and its stated limits Lowest paid plan


[Apollo](https://www.apollo.io/) Contact data An AI sales platform with data on 240M contacts and 30M companies, plus sequences. Free, $0: 900 credits per seat per year, granted monthly. 2 sequences. Basic: $49 per seat a month, billed annually.[Apollo pricing](https://www.apollo.io/pricing)


[Cognism](https://www.cognism.com/) Contact data Sales intelligence: B2B contact data with emails, mobile numbers and job titles, and filters for building targeted lists. — Not published. Standard and Pro packages, each with 5 seats included.[Cognism pricing](https://www.cognism.com/pricing)


[Hunter](https://hunter.io/) Contact data Finds and verifies email addresses and sends cold emails. Free, $0: 50 credits per month. Connect 1 email account. 500 recipients per sequence. Starter: $34 a month on the Pay yearly view ($408 billed yearly), or $49 a month billed monthly.[Hunter pricing](https://hunter.io/pricing)


[Kaspr](https://www.kaspr.io/) Contact data A LinkedIn Chrome extension and web app for B2B contact data: phone numbers and email addresses. Free, $0 a month per user: 15 B2B email credits, 5 phone credits and 5 direct email credits per month. Starter: $65 per user a month with Dollar selected. The page opens in euros, at €59.[Kaspr pricing](https://www.kaspr.io/pricing)


[Lusha](https://www.lusha.com/) Contact data Verified contacts, company data and buying signals, in a web workspace, a Chrome extension and an API. Free, $0: 40 credits per month, 1 seat included, no credit card required. Starter: $37.45 a month, billed yearly, with 4,800 credits per year and 1 seat.[Lusha pricing](https://www.lusha.com/pricing/)


[RocketReach](https://rocketreach.co/) Contact data Finds email addresses and phone numbers, with search across 700 million professionals and 60 million companies. Free account: 5 free lookups, no credit card required. Essentials, email only: $33 a month on the Annually view ($399 billed annually).[RocketReach pricing](https://rocketreach.co/pricing)


[UpLead](https://www.uplead.com/) Contact data A B2B database of verified emails and mobile numbers, with 50+ search filters. —. The page lists a Free Trial: $0 for 7 days, with 5 credits. Essentials: $74 a month billed annually, with 2,040 credits, or $99 a month on the monthly view, with 170 credits.[UpLead pricing](https://www.uplead.com/pricing/)


[ZoomInfo](https://www.zoominfo.com/) Contact data Contact and company profiles with mobile numbers and business emails, plus search, lists and exporting. —. The sales plans show a Start free trial button. Not published.[ZoomInfo pricing](https://www.zoominfo.com/pricing)


[LinkedIn Sales Navigator](https://business.linkedin.com/sell/sales-navigator) LinkedIn A sales tool built on LinkedIn’s network: lead search with 50+ filters, lead alerts and InMail. —. The page says Core and Advanced have a free trial. Core: starts at US$119.99 per license a month, or US$1,079.88 per license a year.[Sales Navigator pricing](https://business.linkedin.com/sell/sales-navigator/compare-plans)


[Clay](https://www.clay.com/) Research and enrichment Finds and enriches data from 150+ providers, with Claygent, an AI agent that does web research. Free: 100 data credits and 500 actions a month. Unlimited seats and tables. Up to 200 rows per table. Launch: $167 a month on the Annual view.[Clay pricing](https://www.clay.com/pricing)


[HubSpot Sales Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales) Email outreach and sequencing Sales software with contact and lead management, email tracking and automated email sequences. Free, $0 a month: free for up to 2 users, no credit card required. Starter: starts at $7 per seat a month with Pay Annually selected, a discount for new customers only. The crossed-out price beside it is $20.[HubSpot pricing](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/sales)


[Instantly](https://instantly.ai/) Email outreach and sequencing Automated email outreach, a B2B lead database, email deliverability tools and a CRM. — Growth, on the Outreach tab: $47 a month on the Monthly view.[Instantly pricing](https://instantly.ai/pricing)


[lemlist](https://www.lemlist.com/) Email outreach and sequencing Sequences across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp and SMS, with a 650M+ lead database. —. The page describes a 14-day free trial. Email: $55 a month on the Yearly view, with unlimited users and 50,000 emails a month.[lemlist pricing](https://www.lemlist.com/pricing)


[Outreach](https://www.outreach.ai/platform/features/sales-engagement) Email outreach and sequencing A sales engagement platform: sequences across email, LinkedIn, SMS and calls, synced to the CRM. — Not published. Per user, plus AI credits.[Outreach pricing](https://www.outreach.ai/pricing)


[Salesloft](https://www.salesloft.com/platform/sales-engagement-software) Email outreach and sequencing Cadences across email, phone and social, with a dialer for calls and texts. — Not published. No pricing page.


Trellus Calling A Chrome extension that adds[power](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) and[parallel dialing](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) inside the CRM or sales engagement platform a team already uses. — Power: $99.99 per seat per month.[Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing)


Every row was read on the vendor’s own pages on November 15, 2026, and links them. Prices are in US dollars before tax, usage and add-ons, for the plan and billing view named. A dash means the pricing page shows no free plan.


This page sorts the toolset by job and by what is free. For free tools beyond prospecting, such as notetakers and CRMs, see[free AI tools for sales](https://www.trellus.ai/post/free-ai-tools-for-sales) .


## Which sales prospecting tools are free


A free plan, a free account and a free trial are different things. A free plan has no end date and a stated limit. A trial ends. Six of the 16 tools show a free plan on their pricing page, and one more describes a free account. These are the limits each page states:


- **Apollo.** Free plan, $0: 900 credits per seat per year, granted monthly, and 2 sequences. The page prices an email at 1 credit and a phone number at 8 credits.
- **Clay.** Free plan: 100 data credits and 500 actions a month, unlimited seats and tables, and up to 200 rows per table.
- **HubSpot Sales Hub.** Free plan, $0 a month: free for up to 2 users, with no credit card required.
- **Hunter.** Free plan, $0: 50 credits per month, 1 connected email account and 500 recipients per sequence. An email found costs 1 credit and an email verified 0.5 credit. Credits reset monthly.
- **Kaspr.** Free plan, $0 a month per user: 15 B2B email credits, 5 phone credits and 5 direct email credits per month.
- **Lusha.** Free plan, $0: 40 credits per month, with 1 seat included and no credit card required.
- **RocketReach.** The pricing page says it is free to create an account, and that free accounts have 5 free lookups with no credit card required.


Four more pricing pages state a free trial and no free plan:


- **UpLead** lists a Free Trial at $0 for 7 days, with 5 credits.
- **lemlist** describes a 14-day free trial with 200 free credits.
- **LinkedIn Sales Navigator** says Core and Advanced have a free trial for members who are not on a paid LinkedIn subscription and have not used a LinkedIn free trial in the past 365 days.
- **ZoomInfo** shows a Start free trial button on its sales plans.


Apollo and Clay show a 14-day trial button on paid plans as well as a free plan.


The pricing pages for Cognism, Instantly and Outreach show no free plan, and Salesloft has no pricing page. Trellus has no free plan and no free trial.


Before relying on a free plan, work out how many days of real prospecting the limit covers. On Hunter, 50 credits is 50 emails found in a month. On Kaspr, the free plan has 5 phone credits a month. On Apollo, a phone number costs eight times what an email costs. A new SDR who calls every day will use a phone allowance faster than an email allowance.


## What paid plans cost


Twelve of the 16 tools publish a price. These are the lowest paid plans shown on November 15, 2026, grouped by job. Each price is per month, on the billing view named.


**Contact data**


- **RocketReach Essentials (email only):** $33 on the Annually view, $399 billed annually.
- **Hunter Starter:** $34 on the Pay yearly view, $408 billed yearly, or $49 billed monthly.
- **Lusha Starter:** $37.45, billed yearly, with 4,800 credits per year.
- **Apollo Basic:** $49 per seat, billed annually, with 30,000 credits per seat per year.
- **Kaspr Starter:** $65 per user with Dollar selected.
- **UpLead Essentials:** $74 billed annually, or $99 on the monthly view.


**LinkedIn, enrichment and email outreach**


- **LinkedIn Sales Navigator Core:** starts at US$119.99 per license, or US$1,079.88 per license a year.
- **Clay Launch:** $167 on the Annual view.
- **HubSpot Sales Hub Starter:** starts at $7 per seat with Pay Annually selected, a discount for new customers only, beside a crossed-out $20.
- **Instantly Growth:** $47 on the Monthly view of the Outreach tab, with 5,000 emails monthly and 1,000 uploaded contacts.
- **lemlist Email:** $55 on the Yearly view, with unlimited users and 50,000 emails a month.


**Calling**


- **Trellus Power:** $99.99 per seat.


**Vendors that show no price.** Cognism, Outreach, Salesloft and ZoomInfo show no price on their sites. Cognism’s pricing page lists Standard and Pro packages, each with 5 seats included, and offers a quote for each team. Outreach’s page says it combines per user pricing with consumption-based AI credits, and shows a Request pricing button. ZoomInfo’s page says its pricing is based on features, the number of licenses and credit usage. Salesloft has no pricing page; its pricing address leads to a page for talking to sales.


Five things change the total:


- **Billing view.** Yearly views are lower. Hunter Starter is $34 a month on the yearly view and $49 billed monthly. UpLead Essentials is $74 billed annually and $99 monthly.
- **Credits.** Apollo, Clay, Hunter, Kaspr, Lusha and UpLead plans come with a credit allowance, and each vendor defines a credit differently. On UpLead one credit is one contact. On Apollo a phone number is 8 credits.
- **The unit.** Apollo, HubSpot and Trellus price per seat, Kaspr per user and LinkedIn per license. lemlist’s Email plan lists unlimited users and prices by email volume. Hunter lists unlimited team members on its plans.
- **Minimums and fees.** Apollo’s Organization plan needs at least 3 seats. HubSpot Sales Hub Professional lists a required one-time onboarding fee of $1,500.
- **Promotions.** HubSpot showed a new-customer discount on Starter that day. Check the regular price before budgeting for year two.


## How to choose a prospecting tool by job


Pick by the job that is slowing the team down, then check the limits on that tool’s own page.


- **Find contacts.** Check what the tool returns: work emails, mobile numbers or both. RocketReach labels its lowest plan email only, and Hunter finds and verifies email addresses. Check where the tool works. Kaspr is a Chrome extension that works on LinkedIn profiles. Check the regions it covers. Kaspr’s home page describes European contact data.
- **Research and enrich.** Check which data sources the tool draws on and how much one run costs. Clay lists 150+ data providers and an AI agent for web research, and meters use in data credits and actions.
- **Reach out by email or LinkedIn.** Check which channels a plan covers and how many emails it sends. Instantly and lemlist list a monthly email allowance on their lowest plans. Outreach describes sequences across email, LinkedIn, SMS and calls, and Salesloft describes cadences across email, phone and social. For the method on LinkedIn, see[how to use LinkedIn for prospecting](https://www.trellus.ai/post/how-to-use-linkedin-for-prospecting) . For platforms that sequence every channel, see[sales engagement software](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-engagement-software) .
- **Call.** Check that the dialer works inside the CRM or sequencing tool where the call tasks live, and whether calling minutes are included. A[power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) calls one number at a time from a list.


Then run four checks on any tool:


1. **Read the free limit before the price.** A credit count, a user cap or a row cap decides how far the free plan goes.
2. **Find out what one credit buys.** The same word means different things on different pricing pages.
3. **Compare like with like.** Put annual prices next to annual prices, and note which currency and which tab of the page a number came from.
4. **Check the handoff.** A contact found in one tool has to reach the tool that emails or calls. Look for your CRM on the vendor’s integrations list.


## A simple prospecting stack for a new SDR


A new SDR needs one tool for each job, not one of everything. The picks below are examples, one per job, and any tool from the same group in the table can take the place.


1. **Find contacts: a contact data tool with a free plan.** Apollo’s free plan gives 900 credits per seat per year, and Lusha’s gives 40 credits a month.
2. **Search LinkedIn: Sales Navigator.** Core is the plan LinkedIn describes for individual sellers. It has no free plan, and the page says a free trial is available.
3. **Research the account: Clay.** The free plan gives 100 data credits and 500 actions a month.
4. **Send the emails: a sequencing tool.** HubSpot Sales Hub has a free plan for up to 2 users; check its pricing page for the plan that includes sequences. lemlist’s Email plan is $55 a month on the Yearly view.
5. **Make the calls: a dialer.** Trellus Power is $99.99 per seat per month and has no free plan.


The first, third and fourth steps can start on free plans. LinkedIn search and calling are the two paid steps in this example. Add a paid plan when a free limit is what stops the work, not before.


## Where Trellus fits


Trellus does the calling step. It is not a contact database or an email tool, so it sits beside the other tools on this list. It is a Chrome extension that adds a[power dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/power-dialer) , which calls one number at a time, and a[parallel dialer](https://www.trellus.ai/parallel-dialer) , which calls up to five lines at once on eligible plans. Both run inside the CRM or sales engagement platform a team already uses. Reps start from a list, task queue, sequence step or report in that platform.


The[integrations directory](https://www.trellus.ai/integrations) shows 31 platforms, including Apollo, Clay, HubSpot, lemlist, Outreach and Salesloft from this list. Trellus dials Apollo call tasks, Outreach call tasks, Salesloft call tasks and cadence steps, and a Clay table with a mapped phone column. After a call the rep reviews the notes, picks the outcome and records the next action, and the directory shows what Trellus saves back to each platform.


Power is $99.99 per seat per month. It includes about 1,300 US minutes per seat each week, voicemail drop and a LinkedIn inbox for Sales Navigator. Power + Parallel is $149.99 and adds parallel dialing and unlimited[AI practice calls](https://www.trellus.ai/ai-sales-roleplay) . Business is custom pricing and adds[real-time coaching](https://www.trellus.ai/realtime-coaching) and team analytics. There is no seat minimum, no free plan and no free trial. See[Trellus pricing](https://www.trellus.ai/pricing) .


## Frequently asked questions


### What are sales prospecting tools?


Sales prospecting tools are software that helps a rep find people to sell to and start a conversation with them. They do four jobs: find contacts, enrich and research them, reach out by email or LinkedIn, and call. Most tools do one or two of the jobs.


### What is the best sales prospecting tool?


No single tool is best for every team, so pick by job. For contact data, compare Apollo, Cognism, Hunter, Kaspr, Lusha, RocketReach, UpLead and ZoomInfo. For LinkedIn, Sales Navigator. For research and enrichment, Clay. For email outreach, HubSpot Sales Hub, Instantly, lemlist, Outreach and Salesloft. For calling, Trellus.


### Are there free prospecting tools?


Yes. On November 15, 2026, six of the 16 tools here showed a free plan on their own pricing page: Apollo, Clay, HubSpot Sales Hub, Hunter, Kaspr and Lusha. RocketReach describes a free account with 5 free lookups. Each free plan has a stated limit, such as 50 credits a month on Hunter or 2 users on HubSpot Sales Hub.


### What is sales prospecting software?


Sales prospecting software is another name for sales prospecting tools. The term covers contact databases, LinkedIn tools, enrichment tools, email sequencing tools and dialers. Some products, such as Apollo, combine a contact database with sequences in one product.


### Which prospecting tools do SDRs use?


An SDR needs a tool for each of the four jobs: a contact data tool to find emails and phone numbers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or an enrichment tool to research accounts, a sequencing tool to send emails, and a dialer to make calls. The stack section above gives one example for each.


### What is the difference between a prospecting tool and a sales engagement platform?


A prospecting tool is the broad term for software that does any prospecting job. A sales engagement platform is one kind: it runs sequences of emails, calls and LinkedIn steps and logs each touch to the CRM. Outreach and Salesloft are sales engagement platforms. Compare them in[sales engagement software](https://www.trellus.ai/post/sales-engagement-software) .


### How much do sales prospecting tools cost?


On November 15, 2026, 12 of the 16 tools here published a price. The lowest paid plans ran from HubSpot Sales Hub Starter, shown at $7 per seat a month as a new-customer discount beside a crossed-out $20, to Clay Launch at $167 a month on the annual view. Eight of the 12 were under $70 a month. Cognism, Outreach, Salesloft and ZoomInfo showed no price. Billing view, credits, seats and promotions change the total.
